<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD top-level scope contains only standard variable and array assignments: pkgname, pkgver, pkgrel, pkgdesc, arch, url, license, depends, makedepends, _pkgsrc, source, and b2sums. The _pkgsrc assignment uses bash parameter expansion ("${_url##*/}") to derive the source directory name, which is a normal string operation. The source array points to the package's own upstream GitHub repository via git+https with a pinned tag, which is standard AUR practice. No commands are executed, no network requests are made, and no code is downloaded or evaluated at top level. The build(), check(), and package() functions are not sourced/executed by makepkg --printsrcinfo, so their contents are out of scope for this narrow gate.
</details>
